g.text: Request types S0, S1 and V pooled. Bars: 95% Wilson intervals (they treat purchases as independent, so they are too narrow when one task

g.text: repeats). Product order is part of every test cell, so position is held fixed by design and cannot explain a name gap. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite:
